interventions.agent: LGI1fl/Hoxb8+ (conditional LGI1 knockout in DRG and spinal cord)

combinations.readout: DTX-sensitive (Kv1) component of slowly inactivating outward current IKD in small DRG neurons
combinations.magnitude: DTX-sensitive current significantly smaller in LGI1-ablated neurons; total IKD reduced in LGI1fl/Hoxb8+ versus controls
combinations.model: cultured small-diameter DRG neurons, whole-cell patch clamp
combinations.evidence_quote: The DTX-sensitive current is significantly smaller in LGI1-ablated neurons (Fig. 3H), suggestive of a loss of Kv1 currents, which would explain the reduction in total IKD (Fig. 3F and G).
